verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents end-to-end EB-1A and EB-2 NIW case building as its core service, covering evidence strategy, petition preparation, attorney review and USCIS filing. Its O-1 page also cites evidence mapped to criteria and recommendation materials. Its own site says it is not a law firm, and its documents never explicitly cover drafting expert or support letters or completing USCIS forms. missing for 10: explicit documentation that LegalOS drafts expert and support letters (not just 'organized'), explicit form preparation, evidence binder assembly details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: Build and file your EB-1A case end to end — from eligibility and evidence strategy through petition preparation, attorney review, and USCIS filing.
Evidence mapped to O-1 criteria. Recommendation materials organized earlier. Attorney-reviewed petition package
collect the evidence, and prepare attorney-reviewed filings in as little as 48 hours
LegalOS keeps preparation, attorney review, filing, and case visibility within one accountable immigration team.
